guidance_main_effect_C_minus_B.reading: excludes zero: inference guidance significantly improves distribution realism inside the pre-repair representation. First distribution-level measurement of guidance in this branch; P2/P3/P5/P6 never made one. Not a budget effect.

offset_corrected.reading: Removing one global fixed vector per cell drops FID 1.7755 -> 0.6332 (A) and 1.4641 -> 0.4100 (B), so a single rigid offset is worth 1.142 and 1.054 FID respectively, and it is 2.79 cm / 2.30 cm vertical. After that removal the residual budget difference is -0.223 with a CI excluding zero, while the raw PRIMARY is null. The honest statement is that the rigid offset dominates the raw metric and inflates the estimator's spread enough to mask a real remainder -- NOT that the budget is significant, because each cell subtracts its own vector and this is not an official model score.
